findings.claim: The S2 contract omits the ordering rule (document key, part number, id) and the duplicate-key case that the Log (lines 19-22) describes as implemented behaviour. The JSON shape has no scope field, so a consumer cannot tell two rows with the same topic_key apart. The Specs are the stated source of truth, so these behaviours exist only in the Log and the spec is incomplete.

evidence: The change adds only a documentation file. No code behaviour is affected.
S2 lists the JSON fields id, topic_key, title and body, and states no ordering. Log lines 19-22 state the ordering and that the same topic key can appear twice.
